sources.title: Concurrent flame growth, spread and extinction over composite fabric samples
sources.quote: A total of 27 tests were carried out for the fabric samples in BASS-II
sources.finding_en: The 27-test total is supported. The 24/3 ignition split needs reconciliation with additional non-ignitions of reused samples in the Appendix. Pressure is 1 atm for this study. SIBAL is 75% cotton and 25% fiberglass, about 0.32 mm thick.
sources.finding_tr: 27 test toplamı destekleniyor. 24/3 ateşleme ayrımı, ekteki yeniden kullanılan numunelerin ek ateşlememe kayıtlarıyla uzlaştırılmalı. Çalışma basıncı 1 atm. SIBAL %75 pamuk, %25 cam elyafı ve yaklaşık 0,32 mm kalınlığında.

sources.title: The USML-1 Wire Insulation Flammability Glovebox Experiment
sources.quote: Ignition of the insulation material was achieved in all four tests.
sources.finding_en: WIF A–D used polyethylene insulation about 0.65 mm thick, at approximately 21% oxygen and 1 atm. WIF-C failed to propagate. WIF-D quenched after airflow stopped. These samples flew on USML-1.
sources.finding_tr: WIF A–D yaklaşık 0,65 mm polietilen yalıtım, %21 oksijen ve 1 atm koşullarını kullandı. WIF-C'de yayılım başarısız oldu. WIF-D akış durunca söndü. Numuneler USML-1'de test edildi.

sources.title: Results of Large-Scale Spacecraft Flammability Tests / Saffire-II
sources.quote: a tiny gas phase flame remained but did not spread and quickly extinguished
sources.finding_en: Silicone specimens 2-1 through 2-4 had a brief local gas flame without sustained burning or propagation. Their thicknesses were 0.27, 0.61, 1.03 and 0.37 mm. Initial oxygen was approximately 22.1%; airflow was 20 cm/s. Pressure is not established by the inspected sample table.
sources.finding_tr: Silikon 2-1 ile 2-4 numunelerinde kısa yerel gaz alevi görüldü, sürekli yanma veya yayılım oluşmadı. Kalınlıklar 0,27, 0,61, 1,03 ve 0,37 mm. Başlangıç oksijeni yaklaşık %22,1, akış 20 cm/s. İncelenen numune tablosu basıncı belirtmiyor.

sources.title: NASA-Mir Phase 1 Science Report / Forced Flow Flamespread Test
sources.location: PDF / printed p. 104, FFFT operational activities
sources.quote: all samples successfully ignited and burned in very low speed airflow
sources.finding_en: The report includes four flat cellulose specimens with different thicknesses. Their ignition and burning are supported. Numerical oxygen, pressure, airflow and thickness values are absent from this section.
sources.finding_tr: Raporda farklı kalınlıklarda dört düz selüloz numunesi var. Ateşleme ve yanma bilgisi destekleniyor. Bu bölüm sayısal oksijen, basınç, akış ve kalınlık değerlerini belirtmiyor.
